title: Rosario Castellanos's birth chart
metaDescription: Rosario Castellanos's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 4.0° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 8.9° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Gemini, but precisely: 4.0°, first decan, 0°–10°, under Mercury in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 10.5° Taurus, Venus was at 12.4° Gemini, Mars was at 10.1° Cancer. Read together: a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; taste led by wit and proportion; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Mars — a sextile holding at 0.5°. The scheme reads a sextile as a door left unlocked. Useful, and entirely dependent on someone walking through it. Behind it, Mars trine Saturn at 0.8°, and Mercury opposition Saturn at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Neptune stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has three entries for this chart. The Moon in Cancer at 8.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Cancer at 10.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Capricorn at 22.2° is in fall. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 5 in water, 2 in air, 2 in earth, 1 in fire by element, 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 3 fixed by modality. Jupiter and Saturn were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 8.9°.
